cards.front: During her period, a 19-year-old using tampons has fever 39.6 °C, diffuse erythroderma and BP 82/48 mmHg. The tampon is removed, and fluids and flucloxacillin are started. The antibiotic added to suppress toxin production is [___].
cards.context:
Toxic shock is caused by toxin-producing Staphylococcus aureus or Streptococcus pyogenes; menstrual cases are usually staphylococcal.

Clindamycin inhibits protein synthesis and so reduces toxin production. It is added to a bactericidal antistaphylococcal antibiotic, with source removal.
